title: Bad Sunset Wilds R time 🤮🤮
description: Only uploading this for comparison sake from the last time this track came around and was uploaded. Not my PB, that was a 1:10.67-still bad 🤮. Disappointed with this time. I wanted a better time. Had multiple runs where I was even or anout 0.05 off WR pace by the first dash panel, only to get a bad hop into the 2nd nisc and thus fail the run. Many times I’d get good low jumps but fail the mists, or vice versa. I wish I could keep playing this track because I 100% would go for a .4x or a .3x even, because although I never got a .1x lap, I know damn well I have it in me to do so. Wish I put on a better performance for this track, I did enjoy the challenge it presented and trying to figure it out
